scene: Holding the brass key, three newly unlocked transit gates swing open.
picture: A wide side-scrolling view of the breezy wooden canopy platform. On the left, a bright red double-decker bus idles at a ramp. The boy stands center holding a brass key and his skateboard. Up high, a paddle steamer floats by an upper dock. On the right, a skate-park shuttle van sits waiting.
